set.body:
Objective
Cost candidate numerical routes with checked shape/byte arithmetic, live source/worker/output/scratch accounting, materialization policy and explicit synthetic/training probes.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-07, FND-08, PERF-01, PERF-02, INF-05. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
execution integration; execution planning/resource policy; operator counters; existing scheduling facilities. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.05, M3.03, M3.05. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Overflow and unknown strict-budget scratch refuse admission or select a certified equivalent route, never a changed ROI/metric.
2. Owned allocations/operator applications/fit counts and scoped reads match measured counters.
3. Probes are budgeted executions, expose holdout access, and do not masquerade as universal latency bounds or model-quality evidence.
4. Small dense blocks may win over operator routes when admitted; resource policy does not silently change population or randomization count.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M3.09: Enforce resource admission and explicit budgeted cost probes
